tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm paper tone: the default page ground (body background) and the ivory section tone. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ivory and sage grounds; the darkest section ground (ink tone) with white text; photo overlays.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep olive: footer, sticky header (at 95% opacity), deep section tone with white text; browser theme-color; HC monogram tile.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Olive section tone (Spa) with white text; admin primary-button hover; 'live' status rule.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Light accent: sage section tone with INK text only (white fails contrast), text selection, decorative lines on olive, 'new' status rule. In the admin's dark theme it becomes the primary button fill.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and outlines on deep, olive, ink and photographic grounds; light pill hover fill.

tokens.name: hairline-light
tokens.usage: 1px rules over photographs and dark grounds (header bottom border, booking-bar separators).

tokens.name: hairline-dark
tokens.usage: 1px rules on ivory: fact-list dividers, meta rows.

tokens.name: field-rule
tokens.usage: Resting underline of a contact-form field on ivory (border-ink/30); turns to ink on focus. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form validation and send-failure messages (hard-coded in ContactForm). 7:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: theme-bg
tokens.usage: Admin (Website Manager) page background.

tokens.name: theme-text
tokens.usage: Admin body text on theme-bg and elevations.

tokens.name: theme-elevation-0
tokens.usage: Admin card surface.

tokens.name: theme-elevation-50
tokens.usage: Admin note and status-banner fill.

tokens.name: theme-elevation-100
tokens.usage: Admin 'saved' chip fill, hover fills.

tokens.name: theme-elevation-150
tokens.usage: Admin card and banner borders (decorative 1px, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: theme-elevation-800
tokens.usage: Admin secondary text (card descriptions, help lines) and the eyebrow colour.

tokens.name: theme-elevation-1000
tokens.usage: Admin strongest text.

tokens.name: admin-primary
tokens.usage: Admin primary button / hc-button fill (deep in light, sage in dark).

tokens.name: admin-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on admin-primary.

tokens.name: status-draft
tokens.usage: Left rule of a draft status banner (4px; 3:1 against theme-elevation-50 light).

tokens.name: status-draft-badge
tokens.usage: Fill of the DRAFT badge, white text (5.8:1).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Page hero titles: clamp(40px, 6.6vw, 112px), uppercase, set in stacked lines. Mobile titles are fitted with fitStyle so the longest line never exceeds 90vw.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section titles (EditorialSplit, Location: 5–5.6vw — 72px at a 1440px viewport), uppercase, may cross into a photograph on dark grounds.

styles.name: display-statement
styles.sample: A quiet house in the old town
styles.usage: Centred Statement between photographic sections: 3.4vw (49px at 1440), sentence case, max 22ch.

styles.name: display-admin-h1
styles.usage: Website Manager start page heading (clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.4rem)). Sentence case.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header wordmark, uppercase; 11→15px across breakpoints, tracking 0.34–0.42em. The site's only logo.

styles.name: body-copy
styles.sample: Hotel Central sits on Ćumurija street, a short walk from Baščaršija.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body default and form input text.

styles.name: consent
styles.sample: I agree to the processing of my data.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Editorial labels, nav, meta rows, fact lists: ALWAYS uppercase. 10px at 1024–1439px, 11px from 1440px.

styles.name: admin-eyebrow
styles.usage: Admin eyebrow (0.72rem), uppercase, olive (sage in dark).

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: --gutter lower bound: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 36px) is the horizontal page padding everywhere.

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: --gutter upper bound (reached at 1440px).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for menu, booking and admin buttons.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Pill button height below 1024px (40px from 1024px).

tokens.name: pill-height-desktop
tokens.usage: Pill button height from 1024px.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height below 1024px; 56px once scrolled.

tokens.name: header-h-desktop
tokens.usage: Header height from 1024px; 64px once scrolled.

tokens.name: field-pad-top
tokens.usage: Form field top padding (room for the floating label).

tokens.name: field-pad-bottom
tokens.usage: Form field bottom padding above its underline.

tokens.name: admin-card-pad
tokens.usage: Admin card padding (1.25rem) and card grid gap 16px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every photograph, section and form field on the public site: square, editorial.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Admin 'saved' chip (hc-radius − 4px).

tokens.name: hc-radius
tokens.usage: Admin cards, notes, status banners; the HC icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, booking steppers (circles), admin buttons and badges. The only rounded shape on the public site.
